title: Best Profound Alternatives (2026): Including No-Sales-Call Options
metaTitle: Best Profound Alternatives (2026), No Sales Call
metaDescription: Profound's brand access is a 7-day trial or a quote. Compare AEOeye, Otterly.AI, Peec AI, Trakkr, AthenaHQ and more you can start today, priced October 2026.
shortAnswer: The best Profound alternative depends on the job. For a no-sales-call baseline, AEOeye's free ChatGPT check and $29 one-time five-engine report. For ongoing tracking you can start today, Otterly.AI begins at $29 a month, Peec AI at $95, LLMrefs at $79, Rankscale at $99 and Trakkr at $100, and AthenaHQ has a free plan. Prices come from each vendor's own pricing page, checked 3 October 2026.
intro:
Most people leave Profound's pricing page for one of three reasons: paid brand access is quote-only, the free trial is short and fixed, or agencies pay per client workspace. This guide is based on public documentation as of October 2026; we have not tested any of these products hands-on. AEOeye is one of the options, so weigh our placement accordingly.

Our position: Profound is not the problem, the way in is. If you only need to know whether AI engines name you, buying into a platform is backwards. Start with the cheapest tool that tells you the truth about [answer engine optimization](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_engine_optimization) (AEO), the practice of improving how often AI systems name you, and graduate when the data says you should.

sections.heading: Why look for a Profound alternative?
sections.body:
Four things on Profound's own [pricing page](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing) explain most searches for an alternative. None of them is about the product being weak.

- **No list price for paid brand plans.** Brands see a free Trial and a custom Enterprise plan, so you cannot budget without a sales conversation. Older write-ups quoted $99 Starter and $399 Growth brand plans; the current page lists neither. A $99 figure now appears only as the base of an agency plan.
- **A short, fixed trial.** The Trial runs 50 prompts daily for 7 days on ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. The prompt set is recommended for your industry and cannot be customized, and the Trial lists no history, exports or API.
- **Per-client pricing for agencies.** Agency Growth is $99 a month plus add-ons, and each full client workspace is a $399-a-month add-on. Three clients would be $99 + 3 x $399 = $1,296 a month before credits; that is our arithmetic, not a quote.
- **More than monitoring.** The page sells an AI Marketer that runs on credits, and says Profound is not only for AI search. If you wanted a tracker, you may be paying for a workbench.

One more correction: the older claim that Profound has "no free trial" is outdated, and so is the idea that you must book a demo just to try it.

sections.heading: Which Profound alternatives can you start without a sales call?
sections.body:
All of the options below have self-serve sign-up: AEOeye and AthenaHQ have a free entry, and the rest offer a free trial. The differences are what the entry buys and how often it measures.

- **AEOeye** is a one-off audit, not a tracker. The free check asks ChatGPT three unbranded buyer questions, shows the answers in full and names the competitors it recommended; the [$29 one-time report](/) adds Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity and ten questions. No subscription.
- **[AthenaHQ](https://athenahq.ai/plans)** has a Free plan with a $25 credit (300 credits) across five engines. Starter is $295 a month for 3,600 credits, where one credit is one AI response, across 11 models. API access and extra credits cost extra.
- **[Otterly.AI](https://otterly.ai/pricing)** Lite is $29 a month for 15 prompts, daily, on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Copilot; Claude, Gemini and AI Mode are paid add-ons. A free trial is offered; the page states no length.
- **[Peec AI](https://peec.ai/pricing)** Starter is $95 a month for 50 prompts, three models you choose, daily, one project and unlimited users. See [Peec AI pricing](/blog/peec-ai-pricing).
- **[Trakkr](https://trakkr.ai/pricing)** Growth is $100 a month for one brand, 50 prompts and all eight of its models, with a 14-day free trial.
- **[LLMrefs](https://llmrefs.com/pricing)** costs $79 a month (marked limited time) for 500 prompts, with a 7-day trial. It tracks keywords, refreshed at least weekly, not daily prompts.
- **[Rankscale](https://rankscale.ai/pricing)** Pro is $99 a month for 1,200 credits, up to 4,800 answers, with a 7-day trial.

Two more if they match your stack: [Nightwatch](https://nightwatch.io/pricing) is €99 a month (€79 billed yearly) with 50 AI prompts alongside rank tracking and a 14-day no-card trial, and [Knowatoa](https://knowatoa.com/pricing) Starter is $59 a month with a free trial and three AI search surfaces.

sections.heading: Which alternative fits which need?
sections.body:
Use AEOeye for a baseline, Otterly.AI for the cheapest tracking, Peec AI or Trakkr for mid-priced daily tracking, and AthenaHQ when you want monitoring plus actions. The table shows the entry point for each, with Profound as the reference.

![A handcrafted wooden signpost surrounded by green plants, with painted travel directions](https://images.pexels.com/photos/29583274/pexels-photo-29583274.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1200)

Compare cost per answer, not just headline price, because each vendor counts differently. Using their own units, our arithmetic gives these approximate figures:

- **Peec AI Starter:** 50 prompts x 3 models x 30 days = 4,500 answers, or about $0.02 each.
- **Rankscale Pro:** up to 4,800 answers for $99, or about $0.02 each.
- **Otterly.AI Lite:** 15 prompts x 4 engines x 30 days = 1,800 answers if every engine runs daily, or about $0.02 each.
- **AthenaHQ Starter:** 3,600 credits at one per response, or about $0.08 each.

AthenaHQ's higher unit cost buys actions and content tooling, not just measurement, so it is not a like-for-like loser. But if all you need is a tracker, paying four times as much per answer needs a reason.

sections.heading: How do you test any alternative before paying?
sections.body:
Write your own buyer questions, run them on the free tiers, and repeat them. A tool you have not tested on your questions is a guess, and a single run is only a snapshot.

1. **Write ten unbranded questions** a buyer would type, such as "best [category] for [use case]". Do not put your brand name in them.
2. **Run them free.** The [free AEOeye audit](/) covers three on ChatGPT; AthenaHQ's free credit and the trials above let you try others.
3. **Repeat the ones that matter.** AI answers shift between runs, so one result is not a rate.
4. **Check the fix, not just the score.** Our guide to [why AI does not mention your brand](/blog/why-ai-doesnt-mention-your-brand) lists the usual causes.

What you will probably find is absence, not hostility. In AEOeye's audit records (127 completed audits from June to September 2026), a brand was named in 17.6% of 892 engine answers, and 144 of the 157 mentions were positive. That sample is small and self-selected, and engine samples are unequal, so do not compare engines from it; the figures are in our [benchmark file](/resources/aeoeye-recommendation-benchmark-2026-09.json).

![Wooden signpost in a natural setting with icons pointing to different directions](https://images.pexels.com/photos/28588525/pexels-photo-28588525.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1200)

sections.heading: When is Profound still the right choice?
sections.body:
Profound is still the right choice when AI visibility is a funded program with a named owner and needs scale or security review. Its listed Enterprise features go beyond anything in the cheaper options above.

Per its [pricing page](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing), Enterprise lists:

- **Up to nine engines**, including Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, DeepSeek, Google AI Mode and Exa Search, plus ChatGPT Shopping.
- **Daily tracking with all-time history**, CSV and JSON exports and an API.
- **Agent Analytics** with integrations for CDNs and clouds such as Cloudflare, Fastly, AWS and Akamai, to see AI crawler and referral activity.
- **SSO/SAML and SOC 2**, unlimited seats and dedicated support.
- **Agency Enterprise** for networks that need tailored client workspaces and a dedicated agency partner.

If you cannot say who will open the dashboard every week, you are not there yet; start with the audit. For the head-to-head, read [AEOeye vs Profound](/vs/profound), and for the wider market see our [best AI visibility tools](/blog/best-ai-visibility-tools) guide. Profound's own plans are covered in our [Profound pricing guide](/blog/profound-pricing).

keyTakeaways: Profound's brand access is a free 7-day Trial (50 fixed prompts, three engines) or a quote-only Enterprise plan; the $99 and $399 brand plans often quoted are not on the current page.
Agencies pay $99 a month plus $399 a month per full client workspace, so cost scales with clients.
AEOeye is a one-off baseline, not a tracker: a free ChatGPT check, then a $29 one-time report across five engines.
Every alternative here starts without a sales call; cost per answer ranges from about $0.02 (Peec AI, Rankscale, Otterly.AI) to about $0.08 (AthenaHQ Starter).
Profound stays the right choice for funded, security-reviewed programs that need nine engines, history and an API.

faqs.q: Is there a Profound alternative with no sales call?
faqs.a: Yes, several. AEOeye's free check and AthenaHQ's free plan need no card or call, and Otterly.AI, Peec AI, Trakkr, LLMrefs, Rankscale and Nightwatch each offer a free trial from a public pricing page. Profound's own free Trial also links to self-serve sign-up; it is the paid Enterprise plan that starts with a demo.

faqs.q: Is there a free alternative to Profound?
faqs.a: AEOeye's audit is free for three buyer questions on ChatGPT, and AthenaHQ's Free plan includes a $25 credit (300 credits). Both are limited. The others offer time-limited trials rather than free-forever plans, so treat them as a way to test, not a permanent tier. As of October 2026, Profound's free option is a 7-day Trial.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest Profound alternative for ongoing tracking?
faqs.a: On published prices, Otterly.AI Lite at $29 a month is the lowest for daily tracking, with 15 prompts on four engines. LLMrefs is $79, Peec AI $95, Rankscale $99 and Trakkr $100. Prompt allowances differ a lot, so compare cost per answer using each vendor's own units rather than the headline price alone.

Only for a one-off baseline. AEOeye's free check tests ChatGPT on three questions and the $29 report adds four engines and ten questions, but there is no daily tracking or history. If you need to watch visibility move across many prompts, use a dedicated tracker such as Profound, Peec AI or Otterly.AI after the audit shows a gap.

faqs.q: How much does Profound cost for agencies?
faqs.a: Per Profound's pricing page, Agency Growth is $99 a month plus add-ons, and each full client workspace is a $399-a-month add-on, with five extra trial workspaces at $199 a month. Agency Enterprise is custom. These are public prices as of October 2026; credits and Enterprise quotes are not published.

definitions.definition: The practice of improving how often and how favorably AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI and Perplexity mention and cite a brand, also called generative engine optimization (GEO).
